name: Getac ZX10-EX G2
summary: The Getac ZX10-EX G2 is the hazardous-area version of a Getac rugged 10.1-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2/22 under IECEx. Getac also states ATEX certification, but the certificate isn't published. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Android 15.

otherSchemes: Android Enterprise Recommended (standard ZX10 G2 datasheet

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 2 (2025-07-10), checked 2026-10-25; ATEX not published; UKEX not found

iecex.marking: Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc

certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ic) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: Ambient −21 to +55 °C. Protect from excessive UV light and mechanical impact (reduced-height impact test). Connection interfaces never used in hazardous areas. Battery never changed, charged or removed in hazardous areas. Not next to strong charge-generating processes. Use only Li-ion battery BP1S1P4990B, BP1S1P4990B-1, BP1S2P4990B or BP1S2P4990B-1.
safety.peripherals: All connection interfaces (USB, Thunderbolt, DC-in, docking connector, LAN, serial) must never be used in hazardous areas (certificate condition). Optional internal modules named in the certificate are covered as part of the certified tablet. USB-C, USB 2.0 host, microSD and SIM slot are barred from hazardous areas.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Named in the IECEx certificate: hand strap, shoulder strap or shoulder harness strap, capacitive stylus and tether. Anti-static screen film for hazardous use. Hard handle (factory option, not user-swappable) and digitizer pen are on the datasheet but not named in the certificate accessory list. NOT for hazardous areas: AC adapters, chargers, spare and high-capacity batteries (replace in non-hazardous areas only).

os.name: Android
os.upgradeLimit: Getac commits to at least three Android versions per product generation (device dependent)

specs.chip: Qualcomm QCS6490 octa-core 1.9 GHz (max 2.7 GHz), Adreno 643, Hexagon NPU 13 TOPS
specs.ports: USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-C (DP, PD), USB 2.0 host, microSD, audio combo; optional smart card reader, barcode imager, NFC; Kensington lock; all barred from hazardous areas
specs.network: Wi-Fi 6E; optional 4G LTE, 5G Sub-6, dual SIM
specs.nfc: Optional (13.56 MHz, ISO 15693, 14443 A/B, Mifare, FeliCa)
specs.gnss: Optional dedicated L1/L5 GPS (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou)
specs.sim: Nano-SIM 4FF; dual SIM with eSIM optional
specs.touch: Dual-mode touch (multi-touch and digitizer); glove-enabled capacitive on standard model
specs.pen: Digitizer pen (datasheet); capacitive stylus named in certificate
specs.apps: Getac Camera, Driving Safety Utility (trial), Monitoring and Management agents (trial)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (16 MP rear, 8 MP front)

strengths: Among the lightest Zone 2 tablets of its size we list, at 1050 g in use
limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
